topic: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS Lima Wayland qualification harness and glibc 2.43 C23 strstr fix
host: Apple M1 Max macOS, Lima 2.2.1 (vz), guest Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS arm64 (Linux 7.0.0-34-generic, glibc 2.43, clang 21)
findings_resolved: cde/programs/dthelp/parser/pass2/htag2/fproto.h manually redeclared char *strstr(const char *, const char *), which fails under glibc 2.43 C23 __glibc_const_generic _Generic macro expansion; replaced with #include <string.h>.
